route.fill.upto.tooltip: Try to FILL target inventory TO these amounts. Courier will not deposit anything if the inventory already has these stack sizes (or more).
route.take.upto.tooltip: Try to TAKE these amounts FROM target inventory. Courier will not take anything if they are already carrying the specified numbers (or more) in the backpack.
route.deposit.match.tooltip: Try to PUT ANY matches TO the target inventory. Stack sizes are ignored - will fill until target is full of matches or courier no longer holds any.
route.withdraw.match.tooltip: Try to TAKE ANY matches FROM the target inventory. Stack sizes are ignored - courier will take all matches until backpack full or inventory no longer has any.
route.deposit.no_match.tooltip: Try to PUT ALL items EXCEPT the matches TO the target inventory. Stack sizes are ignored - will fill until target with non-matches until full or courier no longer has any.
route.withdraw.no_match.tooltip: Try to TAKE ALL items EXCEPT the matches FROM the target inventory. Stack sizes are ignored - courier will take all non-matches until backpack full or inventory no longer has any.
route.deposit.ratio.tooltip: Try to PUT a specified ratio of matching items TO the target inventory. Item stack size in the filter determines the ratio where a stack of 2 is half, 3 is a third, etc.
route.withdraw.ratio.tooltip: Try to TAKE a specified ratio of matching items FROM the target inventory. Item stack size in the filter determines the ratio where a stack of 2 is half, 3 is a third, etc.
route.deposit.exact.tooltip: Try to PUT the EXACT amount(s) specified TO the target inventory. If the courier does not have the stack EXACTLY, or it cannot COMPLETELY fit in the destination, it will NOT transfer.
route.withdraw.exact.tooltip: Try to TAKE the EXACT amount(s) specified FROM the target inventory. If a stack does not exist EXACTLY in the target, or the courier cannot COMPLETELY hold it, it will NOT transfer.
route.fill.minimum.tooltip: Try to FILL a MINIMUM of the amount(s) specified TO the target inventory. Same as 'Fill Upto', except it will only put items if the target will result in having AT LEAST this amount. This check if performed PER STACK.
route.take.minimum.tooltip: Try to TAKE a MINIMUM of the amount(s) specified FROM the target inventory. Same as 'Take Upto', except it will only take items if the courier will result in having AT LEAST this amount. This check if performed PER STACK.
